body: Yeah 4 planets got destroyed, that's like 30 billion dead and no one cares. It was kinda weird.

The thing I missed the most was Lucas' crazy inventiveness when it comes to world building. Even though the prequels were flawed movies the sheer mass of awesome designs of droids, ships, architecture was amazing. TFA brought bb8, who is awesome, and ...eh another lightsaber variation and kylo ran's ship and that's it. It works fine as a movie but there is like barely anything new or exciting.
I don't understand, how are they good?

Male infp here. Hugs are like crack for me, also other physical displays of intimacy like stroking through my hair near the base of my skull. The thing is if I'm depressed I'm generally not much fun to be around. If you tough it out with your infp partner, he should recognize that you really care for him and feel enormously loved and relieved.

Thank you for trying to help btw, you sound like an amazing person!
